name: social-auth
title: Social Login
description: Sign in with Google, Facebook, GitHub, X, LinkedIn, Bitbucket, GitLab & Slack (OAuth 2 + PKCE), with account linking

env.description: X — https://developer.x.com (OAuth 2.0, confidential client, enable "Request email")
LinkedIn — https://www.linkedin.com/developers (Sign In with LinkedIn using OpenID Connect)
Bitbucket — Workspace settings → OAuth consumers (Account: Email + Read)
GitLab — User settings → Applications (scopes: openid profile email)
Slack — https://api.slack.com/apps (Sign in with Slack, OpenID scopes)
Public base URL for OAuth callbacks (defaults to WEB_URL). Callback: <base>/api/oauth/<provider>/callback

notes: Set <PROVIDER>_CLIENT_ID/_SECRET in apps/api/.env — providers without credentials stay hidden.
Redirect URI for each provider: http://localhost:3000/api/oauth/<provider>/callback (provider ids: google, facebook, github, twitter, linkedin, bitbucket, gitlab, slack).
Users can link/unlink providers under Settings → Security.
